integrity: Exact cyclotomic determinant norms, finite-field support enumeration and Frobenius normalization identity are supplied with executable code; finite direct samples are not treated as infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Reduced union in odd characteristic only. Complex incidence counts and 28 bitangents already known. Older equivalent complete arithmetic computation cannot be excluded; no classification of nonreduced schemes or characteristic two. Independent audit not performed.
title: Frobenius arithmetic and exceptional reductions of the \(28\)-bitangent divisor of the Fermat quartic
